## [Server Name] — Community Rules

**Last Updated:** [Date]
**Version:** 1.0

> **By playing on our server, you agree to follow these rules.** Ignorance is not an excuse.
> Staff have final say in rule interpretation. Rules may change at any time.

---

### 1. General Conduct

1.1 **Be respectful.** Treat all players and staff with courtesy. No harassment, hate speech, bullying, or targeted toxicity.

1.2 **No discrimination.** Racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, religious intolerance, or any hate-based language is strictly prohibited.

1.3 **No threats or doxxing.** Real-life threats, doxxing, swatting, or sharing private information will result in permanent ban and potential legal action.

1.4 **English in public chat.** Use English in global chat. Other languages allowed in private messages, party chat, or designated channels.

1.5 **No spamming.** Avoid excessive caps, repeated messages, command spam, or chat flooding.

---

### 2. Gameplay Integrity

2.1 **No cheating.** Hacked clients, x-ray, auto-clickers, macros, baritone, or any unfair advantage mods are banned.

2.2 **No exploiting.** Duplication glitches, bug abuse, chunk loading exploits, or unintended mechanics must be reported immediately.

2.3 **No AFK farming.** AFK pools, auto-fishers, or mechanisms to bypass AFK kick are prohibited.

2.4 **No griefing or theft.** Do not destroy, steal from, or modify other players' builds, containers, or farms without permission.

2.5 **No scamming.** Trade scams, fake shops, bet scams, or misleading advertisements are not allowed.

2.6 **Respect claims/regions.** Do not build within 100 blocks of another player's claim without permission.

---

### 3. Chat & Communication

3.1 **No advertising.** No IPs, Discord links, social media, or other server promotion without staff approval.

3.2 **No inappropriate content.** No sexual content, excessive violence, gore, or NSFW discussions.

3.3 **No politics/religion debates.** Keep controversial topics out of public chat.

3.4 **No impersonation.** Do not pretend to be staff, famous players, or other users.

3.5 **Discord rules apply.** Our Discord server has its own rules — read #rules channel.

---

### 4. Client Modifications

**Allowed:**
- OptiFine / Sodium / Iris
- Shaders
- Minimap mods (no entity radar, cave finder)
- Schematica / Litematica (printer allowed if not bypassing anti-cheat)
- Replay Mod
- Chat formatting mods
- FPS/performance mods

**Prohibited:**
- Any hacked client (Impact, Wurst, Meteor, etc.)
- X-ray (resource packs, mods, textures)
- Auto-clickers, auto-sprint, auto-eat
- Baritone / pathfinding bots
- Freecam / noclip / flight (unless creative)
- Inventory managers / auto-sort (chest/player)
- Any mod giving unfair PvP advantage

*When in doubt, ask staff before using.*

---

### 5. Account & Alt Policy

5.1 **One account per person.** Alts allowed for testing only — not for bypassing bans, afk farming, or vote rewards.

5.2 **Ban evasion = permanent IP ban.** Using alts to bypass punishment extends punishment to all accounts.

5.3 **Account security is your responsibility.** Compromised accounts are not an excuse for rule violations.

---

### 6. Discord & Voice Chat

6.1 Follow Discord ToS and Community Guidelines.

6.2 No ear-rape, soundboards, or excessive noise in voice channels.

6.3 Voice chat follows same conduct rules as in-game chat.

---

### 7. Punishment Guidelines

| Offense | 1st | 2nd | 3rd | 4th+ |
|---------|-----|-----|-----|------|
| Chat toxicity/spam | Warn | 1h mute | 24h mute | 7d mute |
| Hate speech | 7d ban | 30d ban | Perm ban | — |
| Cheating (minor) | 7d ban | 30d ban | Perm ban | — |
| Cheating (severe) | 30d ban | Perm ban | — | — |
| Griefing/theft | 7d ban | 30d ban | Perm ban | — |
| Exploiting | 30d ban | Perm ban | — | — |
| Ban evasion | Perm ban (all accounts) | — | — | — |

*Staff may skip levels based on severity. Permanent bans are appealable after 30 days.*

---

### 8. Appeals

- Submit ban/mute appeals at [appeals link / Discord ticket]
- One appeal per punishment
- Be honest — we have logs
- Lying = permanent denial
- Staff decisions are final

---

### 9. Staff Discretion

Staff may:
- Punish behavior not explicitly listed if it violates rule spirit
- Adjust punishments based on context, history, and severity
- Request screen shares or evidence for suspected cheating
- Temporarily restrict permissions during investigations

---

### 10. Definitions

- **Griefing:** Intentional destruction of others' builds
- **Theft:** Taking items from containers without permission
- **Exploiting:** Using bugs for unintended gain
- **AFK Farming:** Gaining resources while away from keyboard
- **Ban Evasion:** Using alternative accounts to bypass punishment
